title: fix(ui): show free-form slash command argument hints
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Selecting a free-form slash command leaves no guidance about what to type next.

## User Impact

The existing argument text, such as `<message>`, appears after `/steer ` and disappears when typing starts. Commands without arguments or with argument choices keep their current behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse the existing command metadata and composer placeholder without adding components or changing command execution.

## Evidence

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before argument hint](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f387dd93-e7b0-4f63-9ef1-2df678c022b2) | ![After argument hint](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/38d11f66-b3ab-4a5f-842e-570af4d87dfb) |

/steer selected

Captured from the real Control UI against a local Gateway with no model credentials, so the composer shows No models available.

The original before/after images remain valid: preparation moved the hint derivation into the existing reactive composer frame without changing markup, styles, or behavior. The view consumes the prepared hint value. No new state owner or component was added.

## Validation

- Strict scoped lint and formatting pass for both changed source files, without exceptions. `pnpm check:line-cap-ratchet --base 7b205f0d5659b20834360c8f3867221a050b043c` passes. The view shrinks by 12 physical lines, the frame grows by 11, and one redundant view memo is removed.
- `pnpm tsgo:ui`, the Control UI controller guard, and `git diff --check` pass.
- After extraction, all 11 existing suggestions tests pass (3.11s runner wall, one worker). Tests and their 18-line allocation are unchanged.
- Reused proof: all 76 focused suggestions, parser/catalog, composer, and prediction tests passed before this preserving extraction. The retained hint regression failed on the original implementation, and all 55 affected tests passed with the three slash changes combined. No broader suites were rerun solely for this extraction.
- Fresh installed autoreview of the extraction found no actionable P0–P2 issues. It confirmed reactive context tracking, exact command-plus-space matching, static/dynamic choice handling, and goal exclusion. Existing dictation/prediction blanking and the original visual proof remain unchanged.

Candidate: `1535bd8531e0f6840ee819e64ada4628ce696ceb`. Final CI/security observation and merge remain with the parent. No source-line lint waiver applies or is needed. No new tests, screenshot capture, full UI/E2E suite, or live microphone/model session was added.
